name: Ever Teams
description: Open Work and Project Management Platform.

AUTH_SECRET.description: NextAuth secret for sessions and social login, generated for this app. Never reuse a published value.

GAUZY_API_SERVER_URL.description: Gauzy API origin used by the Next.js server, without a trailing /api. Replace it with your own Gauzy API to self-host the backend too.

NEXT_PUBLIC_GAUZY_API_SERVER_URL.description: Gauzy API origin used by the browser, usually the same as GAUZY_API_SERVER_URL. Other runtime settings (branding, captcha, social login, ...) are listed in .env.docker.
